summary: The input is always a three-digit integer, and the three decimal representations contain at most eleven characters in total, so the legal workload has a fixed constant bound that cannot support meaningful asymptotic scaling.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 100 <= n <= 999, so n has 3 digits, 2n has at most 4 digits, and 3n has at most 4 digits

replacement_checks.evidence: The algorithm constructs and examines at most 3 + 4 + 4 = 11 decimal characters.
Authored cases cover both input boundaries, zero digits, repeated digits, a product with four digits, and every fascinating value used by the suite.
